source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: The exact period of its revelation is not known from any reliable tradition. However, the style shows that it is either the middle or the early Makkan period.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Subject Matter
theme.text: The Surah deals with those objections of the disbelievers, which they were raising against the Holy Prophet's message of Tauhid and the Hereafter, and about his Prophethood itself, mostly in the form of absurd allegations and taunts and mockery.
